results.body: 准备签证的银行流水要覆盖多久？我平时只用网银，能不能从网银下载流水来准备？
results.original_provider_bound_body:
如果是普通 Standard Visitor 申请，这份官方材料指南没有统一规定银行流水必须提供几个月。重点是说明资金来源、你确实可以使用这些资金，并结合这次旅行的支出核对是否充足；我不能只凭流水覆盖的月份判断材料是否足够。
获取方面，可以先在网银或银行 App 里找正式电子对账单；没有下载入口的话，向银行索取。这是收集材料的办法，不代表任何下载文件都会被接受。拿到后还要核对账户持有人、交易记录、资金来源和可用资金；不要只发一个余额截图来代替完整说明。
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/visitor-visa-guide-to-supporting-documents/guide-to-supporting-documents-visiting-the-uk#demonstrating-personal-circumstances

results.body: 还是按自费、学生、旅游这个情况准备。除了护照，能给我列一下要收集哪些签证材料吗？
results.original_provider_bound_body:
接下来还需要这些材料；有哪份暂时拿不到，也可以直接告诉我：
- 有效护照或旅行证件 — 核对身份，以及有效期是否覆盖整个计划停留期间
- 在读证明 — 可向学校索取抬头纸证明，说明在读及准假情况，用来支持你的学习情况说明
- 访问目的的证明材料 — 说明这次去做什么；旅游可以先整理真实的计划行程，不把未定安排写成已预订
- 可用资金及来源证明，例如银行流水 — 说明谁承担费用、资金从哪里来，以及你是否能使用这些钱；预算金额本身不是证明
- 在申请所在地合法居留的证明 — 说明你在递交申请的国家或地区的合法居留身份

这是按你的情况列出的待补材料，不是所有申请人通用的强制清单。如果行程或资助情况有变化，我会再调整。

GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/standard-visitor/apply-standard-visitor-visa
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/visitor-visa-guide-to-supporting-documents/guide-to-supporting-documents-visiting-the-uk

results.body: How many months should my bank statements cover for the visa documents, and where can I get the statements if I don't receive paper copies?
results.original_provider_bound_body:
For an ordinary Standard Visitor application, this official document guide does not set one fixed number of months of bank statements for everyone. The focus is where the funds come from, whether you can access them and how they relate to the trip's costs. The number of months alone does not establish whether the evidence is sufficient.
To obtain them, look for official electronic statements in your online banking or bank app; if downloads are unavailable, request statements from your bank. This is a collection step, not a guarantee that any downloaded file will be accepted. We still need to check the account holder, transaction history, source and availability of funds; a balance screenshot alone does not explain all of that.
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/visitor-visa-guide-to-supporting-documents/guide-to-supporting-documents-visiting-the-uk#demonstrating-personal-circumstances

results.body: For a self-funded student applying from Hong Kong for tourism, could you give me a list of the documents to gather? I've already got my passport.
results.original_provider_bound_body:
We'll also need these documents. Let me know if any are difficult to obtain:
- Valid passport or travel document — to check your identity and validity throughout the planned stay
- Evidence of your student status — ask your school for a headed letter confirming enrolment and leave, to support your stated study circumstances
- Evidence of the purpose of the visit — to explain what you will do; for a holiday, outline your real plans without presenting unbooked arrangements as bookings
- Evidence of available funds and their source, such as bank statements — to show who pays, where the money comes from and access to it; a budget figure alone is not evidence
- Evidence of legal residence when applying outside the country of nationality — to show your lawful residence where you are applying

This is a preparation list for your circumstances, not a universal mandatory checklist. I'll adjust it if your travel or funding arrangements change.
